Collect the content for every placeholder

placeholder_map.Rd

Combines content made with define_content(), and any plain values, into the list that replace_placeholders() takes as code_content.

Usage

placeholder_map(specs = list(), scalars = list())

Arguments

specs

A list of objects made with define_content().

scalars

A named list of plain values, each inserted inline. The name is the placeholder ID, so list(total = 42) fills placeholder_total. Quicker than define_content(), but with no description in the validation log.

Value

A named list, with one entry per placeholder ID.

See also

Other content: define_content()

Examples

plot <- define_content(
  placeholder_id = "plot",
  output_mode = "chunk",
  content = { plot(1:10) }
)
placeholder_map(specs = list(plot), scalars = list(version = "0.1.0"))
#> $plot
#> $description
#> NULL
#> 
#> $placeholder_id
#> [1] "plot"
#> 
#> $output_mode
#> [1] "chunk"
#> 
#> $content_expr
#> {
#>     plot(1:10)
#> }
#> 
#> $content_type
#> NULL
#> 
#> $chunk_options
#> list()
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "content_spec" "list"        
#> 
#> $version
#> [1] "0.1.0"
#>
